accessCard.body: Sabhi sessions unlock karne aur apni progress save karne ke liye ek free account banaiye.

moment.title: Kya aapko ek pal chahiye?
moment.subtitle: Agar session ke dauraan kabhi bhi aapko ek pal ki zaroorat ho, toh neeche diye gaye grounding exercises ka istemaal karein.

complete.title: Session poora hua
complete.body: Aap aaj apne liye yahaan aaye. Aage badhne se pehle ek pal rukein.

relatedContent.title: Aur explore karna chahte hain?
relatedContent.subtitle: Apni healing journey mein madad ke liye, neeche di gayi related sessions dekhen.

resourceFeedback.title: Aapko yeh session kaisa laga?
resourceFeedback.subtitle: Hum aapke is session ke bare mein vichaar jaan na chahte hain. Aapki feedback humare sessions ko behtar banane mein madad karti hai.

feedbackTags.relatable: Mein session ko samjh pai aur usse jud pai

resourceFeedback.submissionText: Aapke feedback ko bhejne ke liye dhanyavaad
